Chapter 1 - Introduction to Telephony on the Macintosh / Telephone Manager Initialization Reference

Telephone Manager Initialization Functions

This section describes the functions you use to initialize the Telephone Manager, acquire a tool ID for the appropriate telephone tool, and create a telephone record. It also describes the functions used to configure a telephone tool and access special features for which there are no corresponding Telephone Manager functions.
